mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbound (inbound_id, code, inbound_date, status, employee_id, purchase_id, company_id) VALUES (#{inbound.inboundId}, #{inbound.code}, #{inbound.inboundDate}, #{inbound.status}, #{inbound.employeeId}, #{inbound.purchaseId}, #{tenantId})
mapper.select:

AND i.inbound_date >= #{startDate}
AND #{endDate} >= i.inbound_date
AND i.code LIKE '%' || #{code} || '%'
AND i.status = #{status}

ORDER BY i.inbound_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
